results.term_definition: An energy level is a discrete allowed quantum energy state within an atom or molecule. It is measured in electron volts (eV). When an electron in an atom or molecule moves from a level with higher energy to one with a lower energy this causes a photon to be emitted with an energy equal to the energy difference between the two levels. Similarly, a photon may be absorbed by an atom or molecule if its energy is the same as the energy difference between the present level and a higher level.
